# T-2: Resume loop chunks

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Apply WorkUnit checkpoints to impl-review loop chunk provider calls so successful chunks are reused after a partial failure.

## Acceptance Criteria
- R3, R4, R5, R6, and R10 pass for loop chunk WorkUnits.
- A later chunk tooling failure writes a failed checkpoint and returns structured impl `TOOLING_FAILURE` without successful final artifacts.
- A rerun skips matching success checkpoints and produces final artifacts only after every WorkUnit succeeds.

## Implementation Notes
Keep chunk creation, prompt creation, proposal parsing, and `loopProposalsToImplReviewJson` semantics in impl-review code. Save success checkpoints immediately after parse success.

## Test Strategy
Spec-local integration-like tests stub provider calls to simulate success, later failure, structured `TOOLING_FAILURE`, rerun reuse, and final aggregation. Assert provider call counts, step advancement, reviewRetry metrics, and artifact presence.
